name: Off-Highway Motor Vehicle
description: A vehicle designed primarily to be operated off public highways, a term the statute says includes any motorcycle commonly called a dirt bike, which is where an off-road electric dirt bike lands.

restrictions.rule: Designed primarily for use off public highways; no limit on motor power or speed
Titled, and carries the state's special identification device, when ridden on land other than a highway
Only Class I (four to six off-road tires) and Class II (side-by-side) off-highway vehicles may be registered to ride county roads, so a dirt bike can't use that registration

A parent or guardian may not let a rider or passenger under 18 on one without a helmet meeting FMVSS 218, except on the family's or a relative's private property or while commuting to hunt with a valid hunting license
